description: Fork of exp453 (LION beta=(0.9,0.95), 1.4967). ln_pre/ln_post -> nn.LayerNorm(E, elementwise_affine=False): PURE standardization (x-mean)/std, NO gamma, NO beta (zero learnable params in these norms). Tests whether the pre-LUT norm is purely magnitude calibration. Chain: exp470 (center+scalar) and exp471 (center+per-channel gamma) both ~+0.05-0.07 behind -> per-channel gamma inert; deficit is /std and/or beta. exp472 adds /std back but drops ALL affine. If exp472 ~= exp453 -> /std is the whole story, neither gamma nor beta needed (cleanest minimal norm). If still behind -> beta also matters. q_norm/k_norm/ln_final stay full LayerNorm. Saves checkpoint.
